allow: Bash(git commit --quiet -m 'fix: remover node_modules e dist do Git \(corrige exit 126 na Vercel\) *)

PowerShell($os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; "RAM total: {0:N1} GB | Livre: {1:N1} GB" -f \($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB\), \($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB\); "Commit: {0:N1} GB / {1:N1} GB" -f \(\(\($os.TotalVirtualMemorySize - $os.FreeVirtualMemory\)\)/1MB\), \($os.TotalVirtualMemorySize/1MB\); Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object WorkingSet64 -Sum | ForEach-Object { "Processos node: $\($_.Count\) | RAM: {0:N0} MB" -f \($_.Sum/1MB\) })

PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173,5174 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conns\) { $conns | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "Porta $\($_.LocalPort\) -> PID $\($_.OwningProcess\) \($\($p.ProcessName\)\)" } } else { "Nenhum servidor nas portas 5173/5174" })

PowerShell(Stop-Process -Id 28896 -Force -Confirm:$false; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; "Commit agora: {0:N1} GB / {1:N1} GB" -f \(\(\($os.TotalVirtualMemorySize - $os.FreeVirtualMemory\)\)/1MB\), \($os.TotalVirtualMemorySize/1MB\))
